synthesizedFacts.fact: Dark spots on the skin, also known as age spots, sun spots, or liver spots, are primarily caused by sun exposure and the overproduction of melanin.
Certain medications, such as estrogens and tetracyclines, can increase skin sensitivity to sunlight, leading to dark spots.
Hormonal changes, particularly during pregnancy, can lead to melasma, a condition characterized by dark patches on the skin.
Dark spots can also result from post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, which occurs after skin inflammation such as acne or eczema.
